ARCANA.label: The Lovers
ARCANA.line: You and a rival each find a material.

ARCANA.label: The Chariot
ARCANA.line: Carried forward up to six spaces.

ARCANA.label: The Hermit
ARCANA.line: One floor of this ring counts as cleared.

ARCANA.label: Justice
ARCANA.line: The richest seat gives 10 cubes to the poorest.

ARCANA.label: Death
ARCANA.line: Every crack mended. Your newest material is lost.

ARCANA.label: The Tower
ARCANA.line: A crack, and half your cubes lost.

ARCANA.label: The Moon
ARCANA.line: Led back up to six spaces.

ARCANA.label: The Sun
ARCANA.line: Every spent die comes back, and 10 cubes.

twin.label: Twin throw
twin.line: Your next die is thrown twice and added.

loaded.label: Loaded die
loaded.line: Pick the face of your next die.

pick.label: Door pick
pick.line: Counts as one cleared floor for the door of this ring.

snare.label: Snare
snare.line: Set on your space. The next rival to land there pays you.

ward.label: Ward
ward.line: Spend a die. The next crack, snare or lost duel is turned aside.

push.label: Push
push.line: Spend a die and throw it. A rival on your ring, or its stray, is carried back that many spaces.

transmute.label: Transmute
transmute.line: Spend the d12 or the d20. Every Hazard on this ring becomes a Spring.
